systems.name: 8.1 NCA Kernel Architecture
systems.notes: Replace hardcoded B3/S23 with a small convolutional neural network (NCA kernel) that processes a 3×3 or 5×5 neighbourhood and outputs the next cell state.
tasks: Design NCA kernel: 3×3 conv → hidden layer → softmax over {empty, red, blue}
Implement forward pass in pure JavaScript (WebGL optional for performance)
Support multi‑channel hidden state per cell (e.g., 8‑16 channels)
Ensure deterministic output per agent colour

systems.name: 8.2 Offline Training Pipeline
systems.notes: Train NCA kernels offline using TensorFlow.js or a Python script. Target morphologies: glider, block cluster, self‑repair wall.
tasks: Generate training data from B3/S23 simulation runs
Define loss function: cell‑wise accuracy + morphogenesis stability
Train NCA to reproduce Conway‑like patterns with fewer timesteps
Export trained weights as JSON for browser loading

systems.name: 8.3 Fog‑Aware NCA
systems.notes: Train the NCA to accept fog (0xFF) as an additional input channel so it can predict/reconstruct hidden patterns.
tasks: Add fog channel to NCA input (0 = visible, 1 = fog)
Test: NCA should 'hallucinate' plausible opponent positions under fog

systems.name: 8.4 Mutation on System Purge
systems.notes: When SYSTEM_PURGE fires, apply a small Gaussian mutation to the NCA kernel weights, shifting the game meta each cycle.
tasks: Implement weight mutation function (small random noise per parameter)
Trigger mutation on every SYSTEM_PURGE event
Log mutation history for tournament replay analysis
Ensure mutations don't destabilise the automaton completely

systems.name: 8.5 NCA vs Classic Tournament Mode
systems.notes: Allow tournament hosts to select NCA or Classic B3/S23 rules. NCA agents have different emergent behaviour — new strategies required.
tasks: Add rule‑set selector to tournament UI
Separate leaderboard for NCA and Classic matches
Observe and document emergent NCA strategies
